name: System alert
description: Informative email for the first warning detected by SmartRoad.
subject: [SmartRoad {{severity}} Alert] {{event}} — {{node}}
textBody:
Hello SmartRoad team,

SmartRoad detected a {{severity}} system event affecting {{node}} on {{lane}} at {{time}}.

{{event}}: {{details}}

Current status: {{status}}.
Recommended action: {{action}}

Please review the SmartRoad System Logs for the latest details.

— SmartRoad Alerts

textBody:

SmartRoad detected a critical issue affecting {{node}} on {{lane}} at {{time}}.
